tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text:
Among $\mathrm{Me}_{3}\mathrm{N}, \mathrm{C}_{5} \mathrm{H}_{5} \mathrm{N}$ and MeCN
(Me $=$ methyl group) the electronegativity of $\mathrm{N}$ is in the order

solution.text: $\because$ In Me $_{3} \mathrm{N} \rightarrow \mathrm{N}$ is $s p^{3}$ -hybrid and in $\mathrm{MeCN} \rightarrow \mathrm{N}$ is $s p$ -hybrid Also electronegativity of any element $\alpha \%$ $s$ -character in hybrid orbitals. Thus, order of electronegativity for nitrogen is $$ \mathrm{MeCN}>\mathrm{C}_{5} \mathrm{H}_{5} \mathrm{N} < \mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{N} $$
